vibeCodingRules.title: Always Attach the context/ Briefing Kit First
vibeCodingRules.desc: Before asking AI to generate any code, attach or reference PRD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, SCHEMA.md, DESIGN.md, and RULES.md in your initial prompt session. This gives AI 100% project context so it never makes random architecture assumptions.

vibeCodingRules.title: Scope Prompts to One Feature or Layer at a Time
vibeCodingRules.desc: Avoid asking AI to 'build the entire app' in one prompt. Ask AI to implement a single route, service function, or UI component at a time, verifying each step before proceeding.

vibeCodingRules.title: Enforce Strict Code Rules in Every Prompt
vibeCodingRules.desc: Instruct AI to strictly follow your project rules: Component-first UI, Service-layer API calls, Constants for magic strings, and .env configuration.

vibeCodingRules.title: Paste Evidence, Not the Whole Project
vibeCodingRules.desc: For debugging, provide the exact error, reproduction steps, expected result, actual result, and only the relevant file paths. Require a root-cause fix and a regression check.

vibeCodingRules.title: Request Changed Files and Real Verification
vibeCodingRules.desc: Ask for only changed files or a concise diff summary. Require the assistant to name the checks it actually ran and never accept an unverified claim that something works.

vibeCodingRules.title: Use Fresh Sessions at Milestones
vibeCodingRules.desc: When a feature or milestone is complete, start a fresh session with a short handoff: decisions, current behavior, next task, known issues, last checks, and relevant paths.

promptTemplates.title: Master System Setup & Scaffold Prompt
promptTemplates.desc: Use this planning prompt when opening a new project repository in any AI coding tool.

promptTemplates.title: New Feature Building Prompt
promptTemplates.desc: Use this prompt when building a specific feature (e.g. User Management, Order Entry, File Upload).
promptTemplates.template:
Read `context/RULES.md`, the relevant sections of `context/PRD.md` and `context/SCHEMA.md`, and only the code paths involved in [FEATURE_NAME].

Outcome: [ONE CONCRETE RESULT]
Acceptance checks:
- [CHECK 1]
- [CHECK 2]

Inspect first, then implement the smallest complete vertical slice. Preserve unrelated changes. Keep API calls in client services, business rules in domain/server services, fixed values in constants, and validation at trust boundaries. Update tests and relevant docs. Finish with changed files and checks actually run.

promptTemplates.title: Bugfix & Root-Cause Tracing Prompt
promptTemplates.desc: Use this prompt when an endpoint fails or a UI component throws runtime errors.
promptTemplates.template:
Expected: [EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR]
Actual: [ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR]
Reproduction: [MINIMAL_STEPS]
Relevant paths: [FILE_PATHS]

Exact error or log:
```
[PASTE_EXACT_OUTPUT]
```

Diagnose the root cause before editing. Do not swallow the error, weaken validation, or add dummy data. Change only necessary files, add a regression test when practical, run the narrowest relevant checks, and report the evidence.

promptTemplates.title: Database Schema Update Prompt
promptTemplates.desc: Use this prompt whenever adding new tables or columns to ensure your DB remains reproducible.
promptTemplates.template:
We need to modify our database schema to support [FEATURE_OR_COLUMN].

### Requirements:
1. Create a version-controlled migration file inside `database/migrations/`.
2. Update the master `database/schema.sql` snapshot so a fresh import builds the latest database structure.
3. Update `context/SCHEMA.md` to document the new table or column definition.

promptTemplates.title: Security & Production Review Prompt
promptTemplates.desc: Use before shipping authentication, uploads, payments, personal data, or other sensitive flows.
promptTemplates.template: Review [FEATURE_OR_FLOW] against `context/RULES.md` and `context/SCHEMA.md`. Trace authentication, authorization, validation, data exposure, logging, uploads, rate limits, secrets, and failure behavior. Rank findings by impact and likelihood. Do not change code yet; propose concrete fixes and tests for approval.

promptTemplates.title: Fresh Session Handoff Prompt
promptTemplates.desc: Use at milestone boundaries instead of dragging a long conversation into the next task.
promptTemplates.template:
Project: [NAME]
Current milestone: [MILESTONE]
Completed: [SHORT BULLETS]
Current behavior: [WHAT WORKS]
Next task: [ONE OUTCOME]
Relevant decisions: [ONLY WHAT MATTERS NEXT]
Known issues: [SHORT BULLETS]
Checks last run: [COMMAND + RESULT]
Relevant files: [PATHS]

Read only the listed files and relevant context docs. Verify repository state, then continue with the next task. Do not recap unrelated history.
